verdict.rationale: jo is a personal agent, but organization workspace administration is still a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The only related evidence is that users can invite household members, and each invitee gets a separate private jo on an isolated machine. That is a different feature from an admin managing members, permissions and data policies in a shared organization workspace, and the pack documents no admin console, roles or org-level policy controls.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can manage members, permissions, and data policies for my organization's workspace
